headline: The forklift learns manners: courtesy bays now dodge the swing
lede: Floor Boss's yield law had a blind spot measured this shift: a third of courtesy pull-offs parked the yielding cart right where the loaded rival's body would swing. The bay law now reads the rival's plan and skips the sweep.

notes.text: pullOff is swing-aware: a yielding cart never parks on a knee or tail diagonal of the blocking plan (#2785). Audited ten careers first: 12 of 64 ducks used to land inside the sweep — courtesy was becoming the jam it ducked for. Post-law: zero.

Measured, then refused: deep-rack placement at radius 2 strands 2,230 reachable cells on legal floors, and a turn-hold right-of-way law cascades on congested traffic (97 holds, a missed quota). Both refusals ship as numbers on #2783 with the next slice's spec.
PLAICRAFT #1711: swept and released — every machine-side line holds with fresh evidence; S1 waits only on one phone clap take from Jon (jonq #2652).
